name: regexreplace
algorithm: Replace of every match of (svc|req)=([a-z0-9]+) by $2:$1 over a whole 50 MB log, rounds times, summing the output's length and every 4,096th byte weighted by its position (README.md).

skip.c: no std regex in C (POSIX regex.h is not ISO C, and the MSVC CRT has none)
skip.rust: no std regex in Rust (the regex crate is not std; no crate stands in)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the checksum, far below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own engine; the checksum (the output's length and a positional sample of its bytes) checks that both wrote the same text
notes: Mk Regex.Replace into an arena Reset per round (forward and reverse DFA to each match, then one Pike pass with every capture slot, anchored at the match's start); Go regexp ReplaceAllString (its NFA with captures on an input this long).
